original_target.title: Optimal asymptotic competitiveness for online bin packing

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original exact infimum asymptotic ratio over all deterministic irrevocable online algorithms on rational sizes, with unknown length and no advice. Current results still leave the classical lower/upper gap. New per-bin-delay2609.29589 changes the objective and permits randomized/stochastic models; Hexagon2610.00395 Theorem1.1 determines offline additive configuration-LP gaps for three-item LP-tight instances of bounded pattern dimension. Neither determines the original unrestricted online R_star. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
